So anything later reconstructing `CalendarEvent` from `booking.destinationCalendar` will only ever see a single destination calendar and cannot recover the extra ones added at runtime. However, the diff also refactors update/cancel flows to operate over multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., cancel handler filters all refs; updateBooking now processes all calendar refs), which suggests the system may not rely on persisted `destinationCalendar[]` for correctness after creation—making this more of a data-model/architecture mismatch than a provable broken behavior from the diff alone.
